scores.title: Number scoring table
scores.help: Hot score: weighted, normalised frequency over four windows. Cold score: half inverse hot score, half draws since last seen. Weights are rescaled to 100%.
scores.expectation: Random expectation: each number appears {{value}} times on average in this window ({{span}} draws × {{k}}/{{n}}).

chart.help: Bar colour is the class (orange hot, blue cold, gold neutral). The dashed line is the count pure luck would give in this window.

bao.title: Bao system pick
bao.help: Numbers are ranked by appearances in the chosen window; ties go to the most recent appearance, then the lowest number. Numbers tied with the last one in the set are listed as equal alternatives you can swap in.
bao.set: Your {{size}}-number set · last {{window}} draws up to draw {{no}} ({{date}})
bao.tied: {{numbers}} also appeared {{count}} times (tied with the last number in the set). The most recent ones were kept; you can swap these in.
bao.filler: Fewer than {{size}} different numbers appeared in the window; the rest were filled in by lowest number.
bao.special: Bao {{size}}: your {{size}} numbers are paired with each of the other {{rest}} numbers, giving {{lines}} lines. The jackpot is won when all {{size}} of your numbers are among the {{k}} drawn; then exactly one line matches. (Checked against secondary sources; confirm with the operator.)
bao.rule: Rule check: applying “the {{size}} most frequent numbers of the last {{window}} draws” to {{n}} past draws (each using only earlier data) averaged {{avg}} hits per draw. A random {{size}}-number set averages {{exp}}. Draws with 3 or more hits: {{ge3}} / {{n}}.
bao.ruleSame: Same as random, within normal luck.
bao.ruleAbove: Slightly above random, but that can still be luck.
bao.ruleNone: Not enough history for a rule check.

backtest.title: Walk-forward backtest
backtest.help: For every draw after the warm-up, scores are recomputed from earlier draws only, each method makes its numbers, and the hits against that draw are counted. The random expectation is exact (hypergeometric).
backtest.seedHint: Leave empty for a fresh seed each run; set it to reproduce a run.
backtest.needMore: A backtest needs at least {{count}} draws; there are {{have}}.
backtest.summary: {{tested}} draws tested (draws {{from}}–{{to}}), {{tickets}} ticket(s) per method per draw, seed {{seed}}. Random expectation is {{mean}} matches per ticket and a 3+ rate of {{ge3}}.
backtest.pExplain: The per-ticket test assumes independent tickets; tickets for one draw are correlated, so it is optimistic. The per-draw test uses each draw's average hits and does not need that assumption. A method only beats random when both give p < 0.01 and it is above expectation.
backtest.chartAria: Cumulative average matches per method; the dashed line is the random expectation
